The canonical authoring/export remains source96c4da4b and successful run39736567239; all eight canonical GLBs, the placement, person data and1835runtime are unchanged through the final DEV integration. This is an initial standing example; full photographic likeness/tailoring, the rest of the modular library, other eras, walking, drivers and riders remain open underT-1789.
